name: Kamiya Natsuki
source:
A clerk at the "Ararato" Maid Cafe. Because she was raised as a wealthy young lady, she is over the top selfish and has absolutely no sense of the value of money. It is unknown who was responsible for making her a waitress in a maid cafe.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%AB%E3%83%BC%E3%83%B3%E3%83%AD%E3%82%AA%E3%83%89#.E3.83.A1.E3.82.A4.E3.83.89.E5.96.AB.E8.8C.B6_.E3.81.82.E3.82.89.E3.82.89.E3.81.A8]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
